sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Oh no! All cells are now gray (g). The cursor at the right end paints gray, not green! My earlier assumption was wrong. Let me reconsider.
Looking back at my experiments:
1. First MOUSE at (50, 25) - cursor was at right end - cell turned green (N)
2. Second MOUSE at (50, 30) - cursor was at right end - cell turned green (N)
3. Third MOUSE at (50, 25) - cursor was at left (after LEFT x5) - cell turned gray (g)
4. Fourth MOUSE at (55, 25) - cursor was at right (after RIGHT x10) - cell turned gray (g)
5. Fifth MOUSE at (55, 35) - cursor was at right - cell turned gray (g)
6. Sixth MOUSE at (60, 30) - cursor was at right - cell turned gray (g)
Wait, that doesn't make sense. In step 1 and 2, the cursor was at the right and cells turned green. But in steps 4-6, the cursor was also at the right and cells turned gray.
Let me think about what changed. Maybe the cursor has different modes based on UP/DOWN, not just position. Let me check the cursor state more carefully.
Actually, looking at the cursor output:
- After RIGHT x10: `ggggggggggggggggggggggSSb` - the cursor shows SSb at the end
- Earlier when I first moved right: `ggggggSSSSggggggggggggggg` - cursor was at cols 23-26
Wait, the cursor position changed. Initially the cursor was at the right end (cols 39-42). Then I moved it left with LEFT/RIGHT. Now after RIGHT x10, it's back at the right end.
But the key difference might be the cursor's color orientation. Let me check:
- Initial cursor (right end): top was S, bottom was b (from initial state)
- After my movements: the cursor orientation might have changed
Actually, I think the issue is that the cursor has TWO modes controlled by UP/DOWN:
- Mode A: paints green (N)
- Mode B: paints gray (g)
And the cursor position (LEFT/RIGHT) just moves it along the bar but doesn't change the paint color.
Let me check: when did I last press UP or DOWN? I pressed UP earlier in the game, which changed the cursor appearance. Maybe I need to press UP or DOWN to switch between paint modes.
Let me try pressing UP and then clicking to see if it paints green again.
